sources.entry: Face Data - macOS application used to auto-annotate landmarks from a video.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that auto-annotates face landmarks from an .mp4 video, producing frame images and landmark overlays for use as GAN training data.
summary.what_it_does: Face Data takes a video file (currently .mp4 only) and extracts a set number of frames from a chosen start-to-end second range. For each frame it detects faces and draws facial landmarks, saving the original frame and a landmark image into an output folder. Output is split into an "origin" subfolder with frames named img001.png and a "landmark" subfolder with matching img001lm.png files. If no face is found in a frame, the landmark file is named no_face_img001lm.png. The README says the app uses Apple's Vision library for landmark detection and AV Foundation for video handling. A Python script named crop.py is referenced for resizing the output images to a GAN model's size requirements. Processing can be started and cancelled from the app's interface.
use_cases: Generating face landmark training data for GANs
Extracting frames from a video for a dataset
Auto-annotating facial landmarks in video clips
Creating paired face and landmark images
Preparing images for a GAN model by cropping
how_to_run: Download the binary from the releases page, or
Clone the repository and build the source code in Xcode
Open the app and select a .mp4 video with Select File
Choose an output folder with Select Folder
Set Start Second, End Second and # of Frames (default 100)
Click Start; use Cancel to stop
notable: Auto-annotates facial landmarks frame by frame from a video
Outputs paired original frames and landmark overlay images
Marks frames with no detected face with a distinct filename prefix
Start and end second range lets you choose which part of the video to sample
Built on Apple Vision, so landmark detection uses Apple's built-in model
caveats: macOS only; source build requires Xcode
Image resizing for GAN models is handled by a separate Python script, not the app
